Faruque, NHPC Shri Piyush Kumar, NHPC # ** ORDER ** The Review Petitioner, NHPC has filed this Review Petition against the Commission’s order dated 9.5.2022 in Petition No. 146/GT/2020 (in short ‘the impugned order’) whereby, the tariff of Dulhasti Power station (390MW) (hereinafter referred to as “the generating station”) was trued-up for the 2014-19 tariff period in accordance with the 'the 2014 Tariff Regulations' and tariff of the generating station for the 2019-24 tariff period was determined in accordance with the 'the 2019 Tariff Regulations'. _Order in Petition No.24/RP/2022_ _Page_ **_2_** _of_ **_3_** 2. Aggrieved by the impugned order dated 9.5.2022, the Review Petitioner has filed this Review Petition on the ground that there is error apparent on the face of the record on the following issues: - _(A) Error in grossing up Return on Equity with MAT Rate in place of Effective Tax;_ - _(B) Error in disallowing impact of Goods and Services Taxes (GST) on security charges_ # ** Hearing dated 12.8.2022 ** 3. The Review Petition was heard through virtual conferencing, on 12.8.2022. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Review Petitioner made detailed submissions in the matter. Considering the submissions of the Review Petitioner, the Review Petition is ‘admitted’ on the issues raised in paragraph 2 above. Notice shall be issued to the Respondents. 4. The Review Petitioner shall serve the copy of the review petition, along with this order, to the Respondents by **30.8.2022** . The Respondents are directed to file their replies on ‘merits’ on or before **12.9.2022** , after serving copy to the Review Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder, if any, by **19.9.2022** . The Petitioner is also directed to file the copies of income tax returns, for the relevant years. Pleadings shall be completed by the parties within the due date mentioned and no extension of time shall be granted for any reason. 5. Review Petition No. 24/RP/2022 shall be listed for hearing on **11.10.2022** . **_Sd/- Sd/- Sd/-_ (Pravas Kumar Singh) (Arun Goyal) (I. S. Jha) Member Member Member** _Order in Petition No.24/RP/2022_ _Page_ **_3_** _of_ **_3_** CERC Website S. No. 429/2022
